_comment: Project news shown on the home page. Newest first. index.php reads this file server-side, so no build step and no JavaScript is needed to render it. Fields: date (ISO, used by <time datetime>), label (what the reader sees), title, body, and an optional link {href,text}.

items.label: Jul 2026
items.title: CS1 release published
items.body: Eight institutional CS1 exemplars, classroom tested and evaluated, released ahead of the full volume so instructors can plan Fall terms. Free, with chapter summaries and teaching materials on the site.

items.label: Jun 2026
items.title: Instructional material repository opened
items.body: Syllabi, handouts, slides, assignments, starter code, surveys and anonymized evaluation data are now public, organized by chapter under CS1/.

items.label: Jun 2026
items.title: CS2 chapters in preparation
items.body: CS2 course packages are drafted and being finalized for subsequent-term adoption. They will be added to this site as they are released.

items.label: May 2026
items.title: Cross-institution analysis under way
items.body: Baseline and intervention runs are complete across the testing institutions, with coordinated data collection designed for cross-team comparison from the start.

items.label: Mar 2026
items.title: Codeless PDC modules at SIGCSE
items.body: Chris Bourke presented the low-code pathway — modules that introduce PDC concepts with no code reading or writing at all — at the 57th ACM Technical Symposium on Computer Science Education.

items.label: Jan 2026
items.title: Follow-on NSF award
items.body: Additional instructor training workshops will further infuse AI and Big Data, together with PDC, into CS1, CS2 and Computer Systems courses through the CDER center.

items.label: Nov 2025
items.title: Flag Maker reported at EduHPC
items.body: A visual unplugged activity to introduce PDC — the Flag Maker study across five institutions — was presented at the Workshop on Education for High-Performance Computing.

items.label: Jun 2025
items.title: Peachy parallel assignments at EduPar-25
items.body: Project material featured in the Peachy Assignments programme at the 15th NSF/TCPP Workshop on Parallel and Distributed Computing Education, in Milan.
